hotkey._comment: kind: 'keyboard' (pynput key name, e.g. 'f8', 'alt_r', 'cmd_r') or 'mouse' (button name, e.g. 'button9'). Hold-to-record only.

stt._comment: backend: 'mlx' (default, Apple Silicon) or 'faster-whisper'. model: tiny|base|small|medium. small is the ru sweet spot.

llm._comment: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be set in the environment.

default_mode._comment: Used before the radial wheel (Phase D) exists. ring: dictate|transform|context. sector: clean|short|friendly|tech.
